name: Tobu Yagi wa Sakasama no Ki no Yume o Miruka
original_name: 飛ぶ山羊はさかさまの木の夢を見るか
source:
There is an old-fashioned Western-style building on the hill by Tokyo. Main character has to substitute for his grandfather and become its landlord. He gets to know people there and even falls in love. He thinks that this calm gentle time will last forever...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-march-2007-shirogane-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
东京附近的山丘上矗立着一栋老式西洋建筑。主人公必须代替祖父，成为那里的房东。他逐渐认识住客，甚至坠入爱河。他以为这段平静温柔的时光会永远持续下去…

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-march-2007-shirogane-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
